newsitem.title: USA: Pegasus Gold gets Zortman extension.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus Gold gets Zortman extension.

text.p: Pegasus Gold Inc Monday said the Bureau of Land Management and the Montana Department of Environmental Quality issued a Record of Decision allowing the company's Zortman Extension Project to proceed.
The Zortman Extension Project is in north-central Montana and has 1.4 million ounces of gold -- 60 million tonnes grading 0.71 grams per tonne -- in proven and probable reserves.

Pegasus said the permits will allow the company to mine 72 million tonnes of ore and the associated 54 million tonnes of waste rock. Under the approved mine plan ore will be conveyed to a new heap leach facility on Goslin Flats for treatment and waste rock will be placed in an area, much of which has previously been disturbed by Zortman operations.
Capital for the Extension Project is presently estimated at $50 million.
